4683688.name: Dereck Lively II
4683688.short: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

4065813.name: Alpha Diallo
4065813.short: Diallo (wrist) won't play Saturday against the Pelicans.

4592427.name: Spencer Jones

4432181.name: Julian Strawther
4432181.short: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

4684742.name: Ausar Thompson
4684742.short: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

4433621.name: Jalen Duren
4433621.short: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

6589.name: Draymond Green

3975.name: Stephen Curry
3975.short: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.

4709138.name: Brandin Podziemski
4709138.short: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis
3102531.short: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4432171.name: Moses Moody
4432171.short: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

6430.name: Jimmy Butler III
6430.short: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

2990992.name: Marcus Smart

4396909.name: Aaron Nesmith

4433076.short: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

5157066.name: Johnny Furphy
5157066.short: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

6580.name: Bradley Beal
6580.short: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

4065778.name: Max Strus

5108024.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
5108024.short: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

3913176.name: Brandon Ingram
3913176.short: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

4396818.name: Jordan Miller
4396818.short: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

5060631.name: Adou Thiero

5113969.name: Cameron Carr

4903027.name: Cedric Coward

4600663.name: Zach Edey

3934673.name: Donte DiVincenzo
3934673.short: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

5061589.name: Yves Missi
5061589.short: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

4277869.name: Jose Alvarado
4277869.short: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.

5106270.name: Otega Oweh

5159925.name: Nikola Topic

5061603.name: Thomas Sorber

4712849.name: Anthony Black

4432573.name: Paolo Banchero
4432573.short: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

5214637.name: Noah Penda
5214637.short: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

5107251.name: Izaiyah Nelson
5107251.short: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

3059318.name: Joel Embiid
3059318.short: Embiid produced 28 points (8-20 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 12-14 FT), 11 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and four turnovers across 36 minutes in Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks.

4432446.name: Jabari Walker
4432446.short: Walker (ankle) exited Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks in the third quarter and did not return, finishing with six points (2-3 FG, 2-3 FT), three rebounds, one assist and one steal across 12 minutes.

1966.name: LeBron James
1966.short: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

3904625.name: Tacko Fall
3904625.short: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

4870562.name: Dominick Barlow
4870562.short: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

4871141.name: Ariel Hukporti
4871141.short: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4601023.name: Oso Ighodaro

4701232.name: Mark Williams

4706557.name: Chris Youngblood

4592435.name: Branden Carlson

4914336.name: Shaedon Sharpe
4914336.short: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4594327.name: Keegan Murray
4594327.short: Murray is questionable to play Sunday against the Grizzlies due to left ankle capsulitis.

3907387.name: Ben Simmons
3907387.short: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

4433174.name: Dylan Cardwell

4898371.name: Maxime Raynaud
4898371.short: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4432586.name: Nate Bittle

4433268.name: Trey Alexander
4433268.short: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic

5142718.name: AJ Dybantsa
